An investigator would need to redo some analysis.","problems":["Sentence 'Near-peer 99215 share for 0-3 condition patients; 3% low-complexity panel suggests acuity, but no records requested to confirm' is garbled and the 'near-peer' claim is not on the card; the card shows share of 99215 in 0-3 condition groups is lower than or near all-provider rates (e.g., 0.086 vs 0.083), with 4+ groups roughly double.","Headline says 'excess mainly in 4+ condition patients' but the rationale never presents the by_complexity numbers (24% vs 11.7% at 4 conditions; 34.5% vs 23.6% at 5+) to support it.","'Records came back for 0 claims' and 'No documented 99215 claims came back' are redundant, and 'no records requested' conflicts with the next step to request charts, which may confuse the investigator.","Cited examples are only the two low-complexity 99215 claims; they do not support the headline about 4+ condition patients and no high-complexity claims are cited.","Excess estimate of ~52.7 claims is not mentioned, and the low-complexity examples (1 condition) are only 3% of 99215s, so they are weak evidence to center on.","Next step suggests a targeted sample of only the low-complexity claims rather than the high-complexity driver of excess."]}
